units.source_text: 我從世人之海幻影的恐懼中獲得了一些解放，不再像以往那樣，無盡無休地事事謹小慎微了。

en.t: I was somewhat freed from my fear of the phantom sea of society, and no longer worried endlessly over every little thing as cautiously as before.

units.source_text: 也就是說，為了眼前的需要，我學會了厚顏無恥。

en.t: In other words, for the needs immediately before me, I had learned to be shameless.

units.source_text: 離開高円寺的公寓後，我對京橋一家小酒館的老闆娘說：「我跟她分手了。」

en.t: After leaving the apartment in Koenji, I said to the proprietress of a small bar in Kyobashi, "I broke up with her."

units.source_text: 單是這麼一句話，就足夠了，我已獲勝。

en.t: That single sentence was enough; I had already won.

units.source_text: 從那天晚上起，我大模大樣地住進小酒館的二樓，

en.t: From that night on, I brazenly moved into the second floor of the little bar,

units.source_text: 可是，理應十分可怕的世人，卻未對我進行任何加害行為，

en.t: and yet society, which ought to have been terribly frightening, did me no harm at all,

units.source_text: 而我也沒向世人做任何辯解。

en.t: nor did I offer society any explanation.

units.source_text: 只要老闆娘願意，一切都不成問題，順理成章。

en.t: As long as the proprietress was willing, everything was fine and fell naturally into place.
